plugin.name: Agent Skills Library
plugin.description: Safely manage complete Agent Skills, read linked files on demand, and run supported Python scripts only after per-skill authorization.
page.title: Agent Skills Library
page.subtitle: Import SKILL.md, references, templates, assets, and scripts as one managed skill. Neko can read them on demand; Python scripts run only after you authorize that skill.
page.securityNote: Authorization and execution are separate actions. If scripts change during refresh, you must authorize them again.
status.storeFault: Import, delete, authorization, and script execution are disabled to prevent changes that only appear to be saved. Reload the plugin and try again.
settings.title: Import roots and safety limits
settings.allowedRootsHint: These roots are only used to select a source. A successful import is copied into plugin-managed storage.
limits.managed: Imports are always protected by file-count and size limits.
empty.title: No managed skills yet
empty.body: Import a complete skill from an allowed directory, or paste a lightweight skill containing only SKILL.md.
import.title: Import Agent Skill
import.subtitle: Directory mode safely copies the whole skill. Paste mode creates only SKILL.md.
import.modePasteHint: For skills that only contain instructions
import.skillIdHint: Leave blank to derive it from the frontmatter name.
import.pathHint: The path must be inside an allowed root configured above.
read.title: Try reading
read.hint: Only managed relative paths in this skill's manifest can be read. Binary assets expose metadata only.
read.empty: This file has no displayable text content.
run.title: Run an authorized script
run.permissionRequired: This skill does not have script permission. Explicitly authorize it on the skill card first.
run.argvHint: Lines are not split on spaces or passed to a shell. Each line is one literal argument. Artifact scripts must write to NEKO_SKILL_OUTPUT_DIR.
skill.authorizedHint: Neko may run the supported scripts below when the request is explicit.
skill.blockedHint: All script runs are denied by default. Review the scripts and dependencies, then authorize explicitly.
confirm.authorize: Confirm that you reviewed the scripts and authorize this skill to run its imported Python scripts?
confirm.revoke: Revoke script permission for this skill?
confirm.delete: Delete this managed skill? Its managed copy will be removed.
toast.refreshed: Skill refreshed; authorization is revoked automatically if scripts changed
toast.runFinished: Script run finished; review the result
error.loadFailed: Could not load the skill library state
